sql: SELECT "bridge"."architect_id" AS k, (CAST("bridge"."length_feet" AS REAL) / "bridge"."length_meters") AS m1 FROM "bridge" WHERE (CAST("bridge"."length_feet" AS REAL) / "bridge"."length_meters") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: bridge.bridge length in feet relative to bridge length
why: bridge length in feet / bridge length: a ratio of two quantities in m
rank bridge rows by bridge length in feet relative to bridge length

sql: SELECT "bridge"."architect_id" AS k, (CAST("bridge"."length_meters" AS REAL) / "bridge"."length_feet") AS m1 FROM "bridge" WHERE (CAST("bridge"."length_meters" AS REAL) / "bridge"."length_feet") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: bridge.bridge length relative to bridge length in feet
why: bridge length / bridge length in feet: a ratio of two quantities in m
rank bridge rows by bridge length relative to bridge length in feet

sql: SELECT "bridge"."architect_id" AS k, ("bridge"."length_feet" - "bridge"."length_meters") AS m1 FROM "bridge" WHERE ("bridge"."length_feet" - "bridge"."length_meters") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: bridge.bridge length in feet minus bridge length
why: bridge length in feet - bridge length: both in m and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same one bridge
rank bridge rows by bridge length in feet minus bridge length

sql: SELECT "bridge"."architect_id" AS k, (CAST(("bridge"."length_feet" - "bridge"."length_meters") AS REAL) / "bridge"."length_meters") AS m1 FROM "bridge" WHERE (CAST(("bridge"."length_feet" - "bridge"."length_meters") AS REAL) / "bridge"."length_meters") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: bridge.relative difference of bridge length in feet from bridge length
why: (bridge length in feet - bridge length) / bridge length: the relative difference of two quantities in m
rank bridge rows by relative difference of bridge length in feet from bridge length
